title: Navigating the transitional window for organic semiconductor single crystals towards practical integration: from materials, crystallization, and technologies to real-world applications
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,1699-1732
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS00987H, Review Article
Xianshuo Wu, Xiaoting Zhu, Lingjie Sun, Shihan Zhang, Yiwen Ren, Zhaofeng Wang, Xiaotao Zhang, Fangxu Yang, Hao-Li Zhang, Wenping Hu
Four key aspects—materials, crystallization, technologies, and applications of OSSCs are timely tracked and emphasized in the review to bridge the gap toward practical integration.
